summary: The Earthen Throne is the ancient seat of the Earthen King, carved from the oldest mountain-heart of the Plane of Earth. Crystal terraces, tectonic chambers, and stone-forged halls form the domain of elemental sovereignty.
history: Formed when primordial stone compressed into the first mountain-heart.
Crystal terraces grew upward as resonance accumulated over millennia.
Tectonic chambers formed from deep pressure shifts beneath the throne.
The Earthen King claimed the throne after defeating rival elemental lords.
